outcome.answer: Several approaches address “parameter importance” when deciding what to freeze in multimodal/LLM fine-tuning. AWARe assigns activation-based importance scores to parameters and then selectively freezes parameters deemed essential for preserving upstream capabilities, aiming to mitigate catastrophic forgetting during MLLM fine-tuning [2]. Model-Dowser measures an importance score for each parameter using weight magnitudes, input activations, and output sensitivities, then selectively preserves high-importance parameters during sparse fine-tuning to mitigate catastrophic forgetting [4].
